name: Coin massage chair

purpose.for: Bathers resting after the bath in Umi-no-yu's lobby: the regulars cooling down in their after-bath clothes, and Mr Fujita, whose back is always stiff from the boat.
purpose.why: Ten minutes of kneading for a ¥100 coin after a 42-degree soak; a sentō's lobby kept one so the regulars stayed for a coffee milk and the night game.
purpose.where: In the Umi-no-yu lobby by the milk cooler, its back to the east wall on the men's side, facing the room: where the onsen's chair stands now (onsen.js).

spots.label: Put a ¥100 coin in
spots.note: Where Fujita stands bent double to feed the coin box (the film's panel 4b, room x 3.72, z 3.3).

replaces.world: johansson-town/src/world/interiors/onsen.js: the boxes named Massage chair seat, back and arm, and the collider round them

placement.why: Asset frame to room: room x = 4.505 - z, room z = 3.55 + x. The body's footprint is the old collider exactly (room x 4.2-4.81, z 3.1-4.0).

replaces.keep: World keeps drawing what moves or lights: the coin timer's readout and lamp, the kneading rollers and the cord to the 1994 socket (onsen-electrics.js). The model names those parts and gives their anchors.

notes: A 1990s lobby massage chair, made up (no maker's name). Colours from World's palettes: the residents' cloth palette (src/avatars/recipe.js PALETTE.cloth); plate is the milk cooler's shelf grey (onsen-lobby.js) and lamp the onsen chair's running lamp (onsen-electrics.js). The sky-blue vinyl stands out from the lobby's brown wainscot, cream plaster and hinoki boards, from the red milk cooler beside it, and from the white and beige after-bath clothes of whoever sits in it. Its seat is 0.50 m (the onsen's seat and World's chair poses), not the 0.45 m of a real one.
keepClearFrom: modeller/tools/keep-clear.mjs on 2026-10-10: World's residents (src/avatars, read only) seated in every seated pose, in their clothes and after-bath clothes, and Mr Fujita in ChairUncurl and FrozenAbsurd with the cloud of hair; 5 cm bands with 5 mm to spare. Cloth that sinks into a seat's top is World's seat contact and is not counted.

parts.name: Massage chair cord
parts.note: Lies on the floor beside the chair. A room that wires the chair itself (Umi-no-yu draws its own cord to the 1994 socket) hides this part and starts its cord at the cord anchor.
